history.note: reproduced against deployed API; reframed from stale-state to latency

tasks.reframe: DOES NOT REPRODUCE as scoped on 2026-10-21. Adding a module refreshes the dashboard correctly: OverviewTab calls loadDashboard() explicitly from the Manage panel's onChanged handler, and the sheet shows 'Adding...' with the button disabled. Measured: click to visible = 2.06s. The cause of user 5's complaint is backend latency, not stale state: /health alone returns in ~0.96-1.05s on the Render free tier, and a module add involves POST + modules + dashboard + activity.
tasks.recommended_scope: Perceived speed, not correctness. Options: optimistic insert of the new module row, and parallelising the post-add refetches. Backend cold start is the dominant cost and is a tier limit, not a code defect.

tasks.title: Schedule the POPIA purge — deleted accounts are never erased
tasks.description: DELETE /auth/account soft-deletes (is_active=False, deleted_at set, password scrubbed) but the row keeps the student's email and full name. purge_expired_users() erases rows past POPIA_RETENTION_DAYS=30 and is tested, but its ONLY caller is the manual admin endpoint POST /admin/purge-deleted-users. There is no scheduler or cron anywhere in the codebase, so the 30-day erasure the privacy policy promises never happens unless a human calls the API.
acceptance_criteria: An account soft-deleted more than 30 days ago is physically gone without manual action
The purge runs automatically on service start (Render free tier has no cron)
A test proves the trigger actually invokes the purge, not just that purge works
